digest.component_or_area: verify plan-review and material-pin policy enforcement for rebar project
propositions: Enable verify.enforce_plan_material_pins and verify.require_plan_review_for_close in rebar.toml while retaining false defaults in reusable schema.
Prove both policies enforce correctly: legacy unpinned attestations pass, stale material-pin drift blocks with exit 1, and missing close-plan review blocks with exit 1.
Demonstrate no eager backfill, graph-wide invalidation event, new pin command, list-output change, or stored relation migration occurs after enablement.
Prove unchanged successful re-review produces no further propagation and in-progress self-edit invalidates close until fresh execution review.
Normalize depends_on and inbound blocks references to canonical prerequisites and verify direct and transitive invalidation only after actual material changes.
Prove enable/disable/re-enable cycling, deleted/archived target handling, concurrency rechecks, code-only close freshness, and execution-phase adaptation through public lifecycle surfaces.
